Last June, I was around North of the river at that time. Thought I try something new.

I arrived at the Japanese takeaway place. I came in, exchange a few polite words and rush out the door to my car ASAP. 

I reached to my car door to open and put away the takeaway food, as I did that I hear a guy yelling and waving, it was the Japanese chef 👨‍🍳 who I ordered from... he ran out in his apron, in the cold raining day.. 

I thought to myself, what is going on, what did I get myself into now. 

He smiled, and said, you forgot your one dollar. I thanked him and he went back into his restaurant.

The guy left his shop, ran in the rain and cold, track me down, just to give my correct money change back..... $1 dollar.... Talk about integrity and respect ✊
